title: The Sticky Note Lesson
short_teaser: A product can become valuable after someone discovers its purpose.
story: The adhesive behind the Post-it Note was not originally created for sticky notes. It became useful when someone recognized a different possibility. A product can become valuable after someone discovers its purpose. Innovation is rarely a single flash of brilliance. It is more often a chain of observations, experiments, revisions, and connections that gradually turn possibility into something useful. The lasting importance is simple: innovation often comes from connecting an existing idea with a new need.
impact: Innovation often comes from connecting an existing idea with a new need. Innovation grows when people treat imperfect results as information rather than proof that an idea should be abandoned. This matters because the lesson is transferable. It can help someone recognize a pattern, make a more thoughtful choice, or see possibility where they previously saw only a problem.
spark_application: What resource do you already have that could be used differently? Choose one idea and run a tiny experiment. Decide in advance what you want to learn, not only what you hope will succeed. Afterward, save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
